description: This file contains various functions and configuration settings related to platform-specific upgrade procedures for embedded devices, including device-specific upgrade logic, UBI partition management, and environment variable handling.

methods.name: xiaomi_initramfs_prepare
methods.description: Prepares Xiaomi devices with initramfs by wiping UBI partitions if necessary.

methods.name: asus_initial_setup
methods.description: Removes existing Linux and JFFS2 volumes during initial Asus device setup.

methods.name: remove_oem_ubi_volume
methods.description: Removes OEM UBI volume given its name, attaching UBI if not already attached.

methods.name: tplink_get_boot_part
methods.description: Determines the current root filesystem partition based on kernel args or U-Boot environment.

methods.name: tplink_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs upgrade for TP-Link devices, toggling boot partition and removing OEM volumes.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Stub function that always returns success, used to verify image compatibility.

methods.name: platform_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Performs device-specific pre-upgrade tasks based on board name.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade handling function, dispatching to device-specific upgrade procedures based on board name.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration data to devices that require it during upgrade.
